Step 1 On damp face, gently massage the face wash for 1-2 minutes Step 2 Rinse with water and pat dry. For best results, use it once a day for 3 months. Important Information To see a noticeable difference in your skin, it is recommended that you use this 2.5% Benzoyl Peroxide regularly and consistently for 3-4 months. We recommend doing a patch test before starting any new product on your skin. You can conduct a patch test by following the below steps: 1. Apply the product to a small patch of skin either to the arm or bend of the elbow 2. Keep the area dry 3. Leave on for 12-24 hours (or lesser if the product isn’t a leave-on product) 4. If any redness, itching, or irritation is observed at any time during the test, do not use the product, else you can safely use it. Its best suited to treat Severe persistent acne in teenagers and adults How long till I see visible results? You can start seeing visible results in 3 to 4 weeks period.
